paper_metadata.title: CogView: Mastering Text-to-Image Generation via Transformers
paper_metadata.abstract: Text-to-Image generation in the general domain has long been an open problem, which requires both a powerful generative model and cross-modal understanding. We propose CogView, a 4-billion-parameter Transformer with VQ-VAE tokenizer to advance this problem. We also demonstrate the finetuning strategies for various downstream tasks, e.g. style learning, super-resolution, text-image ranking and fashion design, and methods to stabilize pretraining, e.g. eliminating NaN losses. CogView achieves the state-of-the-art FID on the blurred MS COCO dataset, outperforming previous GAN-based models and a recent similar work DALL-E.

extraction_data.innovation: Three-region sparse attention: partitions the image into three regions to accelerate high-resolution autoregressive generation; PB-relax and Sandwich-LN: optimization techniques for stable training; VQVAE-based autoregressive generation: discretizes images into tokens and generates them token-by-token, enabling Transformer-based text-to-image synthesis.
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Style learning, super-resolution, text-image ranking, fashion design, image captioning, self-reranking, Style-specific fine-tuning (Chinese traditional drawing, oil painting, sketch, cartoon, fashion)
extraction_data.research_problem: Text-to-image generation in the general domain
extraction_data.application: Text-to-image generation, style learning, super-resolution, text-image ranking, fashion design
extraction_data.paper_title: CogView: Mastering Text-to-Image Generation via Transformers
extraction_data.finetuning_data: ~2 million images cropped to 256x256 and downsampled to 128x128 for super-resolution; 1, 000 images each for four styles (Chinese traditional drawing, oil painting, sketch, cartoon) extracted from search engines, 1, 000 images per style (Chinese traditional drawing, oil painting, sketch, cartoon); 10 million fashion-caption pairs
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Three-region + blockwise window sparse attention, Standard Transformer attention (O(n^2) complexity), Three-region sparse attention
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Two-stage: (1) discrete Auto-Encoder (VQ-VAE) for image tokenization; (2) GPT optimizes NLL losses by concatenating text and image tokens.
extraction_data.vision_encoder: VQ-VAE encoder (maps HxWx3 to h x w x d)
